name: Helping Babies Breathe (HBB)
product_description: Helping Babies Breathe is a freely available skills-based neonatal-resuscitation curriculum and facilitator-support package developed by the American Academy of Pediatrics for birth attendants and other health professionals in resource-limited settings.
